name: kaleidara
description: Create, colour and publish premium printable artwork from ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Create, colour and publish printable artwork
interface.longDescription: Kaleidara is a creative publishing workflow for mandalas, colouring pages, colour-by-numbers artwork and seamless patterns. It helps turn concepts into print-aware book assets, with human review and KDP validation built into the workflow.
defaultPrompt: Help me create a premium mandala colouring-book concept.
Turn this artwork brief into a colour-by-numbers production plan.
Prepare a KDP-ready colouring-book checklist for this project.
